# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are released for the latest major version.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public issues. Report them privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/andreacolzani/laravel-pgarray/security/advisories/new) instead.

You will receive a response as soon as possible. Once the issue is confirmed, a fix will be released and the vulnerability disclosed in the advisory.
